environment.description: ECS Fargate task running notification-consumer-role with full PutItem access to user_notifications table. SQS queue accepts messages from multiple upstream services via SendMessage permission. Frontend notification panel renders stored HTML directly via innerHTML. No input sanitization in consumer or frontend. IAM policy on consumer role: Allow dynamodb:PutItem on arn:aws:dynamodb:*:*:table/user_notifications with no condition keys.
